_doc: SutraVerse 2.0 character bible (rig: brand2/cast2.js). One entry per character. Never redraw a registered character by hand; add new characters here first and render their sheet with sheet2.py.

chanakya.role: Chanakya Files host: the strategist (c. 4th century BCE). Teacher, minister to Chandragupta Maurya. Lean, intense, shaved head with the untied shikha of his vow (tradition), ochre cloth, sacred thread.

riya.role: Office Shastra lead, 27, product analyst in Bengaluru. Sharp, fair-minded, gets talked over.

kabir.role: Office Shastra / Ghar Ki Baat, 29, backend engineer. People-pleaser learning to say no.

malhotra.role: Office Shastra boss, 52, VP. Charming in meetings, takes credit, plays favourites.

maa.role: Ghar Ki Baat mother, 54. Loves through food, never says it.

tanvi.role: Ghar Ki Baat / Mind Games: Kabir's younger sister, 26, UX designer in Pune. Warm, teasing, keeps the family group chat alive; hides hurt behind jokes.

papa.role: Ghar Ki Baat father, 58: Kabir and Tanvi's father, retired bank officer in Indore. Proud, stubborn, turns up the TV instead of talking; softens late.
